title: Norwegian Gratin with Mascarpone
description: A rich and creamy gratin dish inspired by Norwegian cuisine, perfect for a cold evening. This gratin combines roasted vegetables with a tangy mascarpone sauce.

ingredients.name: Fix Fennel
ingredients.notes: Anise-flavored fennel adds a unique twist to the dish

ingredients.name: Norwegian Fontina Cheese
ingredients.notes: Melts beautifully and adds a rich flavor

ingredients.name: Quick Chives
ingredients.notes: Adds a pop of color and freshness

ingredients.name: Gratin Breadcrumbs (optional)
ingredients.notes: Adds a crunchy texture to the dish

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cubed butternut squash, sliced fennel, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Toss to coat.
Transfer the squash mixture to a baking dish and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Meanwhile, in a separate bowl, combine the mascarpone cheese, Norwegian fontina cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Mix until smooth.
Once the squash is tender, remove it from the oven and top with the mascarpone mixture.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with toasted breadcrumbs (if using).
Garnish with chopped chives and serve hot.
